topic: Pfister keystone methods applied to a corpus wayfinder API: calibration and outcome instruments, the research ingest behind them, and the shipped API change they motivated

subtopics.scope: Tomas Pfister's arXiv record and its mapping onto google-research repos (tft, tabnet, fixmatch, uda, timesfm, CutPaste/SPADE, Distilling Step-by-Step, Chain of Agents) as the ingest substrate for the wayfinder transplant screen.
seed_queries: Tomas Pfister Google Research arXiv papers
google-research tft tabnet fixmatch timesfm repositories

subtopics.scope: The six cross-cutting lessons from the Pfister catalog (encode problem structure, selective labels, interpretability as a modeling constraint, explicit distribution shift, decision-centric evaluation, positive controls) restated as hard constraints.
seed_queries: semi-supervised learning unlabeled data pseudo-labels consistency survey
forecasting evaluation uncertainty decision making pre-registration

subtopics.scope: Normal-only anomaly detection needs a synthetic positive control: CutPaste self-supervised anomaly detection, SPADE, and how synthetic defects let a detector state its detection power.
seed_queries: SPADE semi-supervised anomaly detection synthetic defects

subtopics.scope: The ideate-solo transplant screen: 8 variations scored on painkiller strength, switching cost, defensibility under a recorded do-not-do contract, and testability, with ship, defer, and reject verdicts.
seed_queries: innovation idea selection criteria painkiller switching cost defensibility
falsifiability testability criteria evaluating research proposals

subtopics.scope: The calibration instrument POST /api/map/control: a fixed CutPaste-splice recipe, an exact-corpus baseline gate, per-control deltas measured through the real preview path, and quantization-silent readings.
seed_queries: synthetic perturbation calibration false alarm rate measurement instrument
mutation testing fixed recipe deterministic seed coverage

subtopics.scope: The outcomes/1 append-only ledger: two-phase pre-registration (predicted_delta as pending, later verdict row with supersedes), a closed verdict vocabulary, refused score inputs, and contingency counts with no rates or z scores.
seed_queries: preregistration registered reports predictions open science
append-only audit log event sourcing design immutable records

subtopics.scope: The honesty boundary: what instrument readings and ledger rows do and do not claim, preserved recorded negatives, and the line between an instrumentation outcome and task quality.
seed_queries: construct validity measurement versus task performance evaluation
negative results preservation publication bias research integrity

subtopics.scope: Deferred variants reframed inside the honesty boundary: V3 as axis-trial/1 leave-one-out predictability against a fixed-margin null with admitted:false hard-coded, V5 as consistency/1 stability readings with caller-supplied variants and no gating.
seed_queries: leave-one-out nearest neighbor predictability permutation null fixed margins
test-time augmentation consistency stability agreement statistics

subtopics.scope: Deployment receipts as a verification discipline: byte-identical module rebuild checks, pre-upload snapshot comparison against the live worker, KV refresh, and a live smoke on a pinned frame with recorded hashes.
seed_queries: reproducible builds byte-identical bundle esbuild verification
deployment smoke testing production verification checklist
